title_en: Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. v. Peng Xionghun and Hongrun Group Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. — dispute over a pre-sale contract for commercial housing
ruling_gist_en: According to Article 108(4) and Article 38 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, a jurisdictional objection refers to a party's objection as to whether a case falls within the scope of a people's court's acceptance or whether it is under the jurisdiction of the court hearing the case. A party has the right to raise a jurisdictional objection, but a party raising a jurisdictional objection on the ground that it is not a proper defendant does not comply with the above provisions and does not constitute a jurisdictional objection. Whether a party is a proper defendant shall be determined through substantive trial by the people's court.

full_text_en:
Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.

v.

Peng Xionghun (PENG STEPHEN) and Hung Yun Group Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. (HUNG YUN GROUP LIMITED)

— dispute over commercial housing pre-sale contract

Ruling Summary

Pursuant to Article 108(4) and Article 38 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, an objection to jurisdiction refers to an objection raised by a party as to whether a case falls within the scope of the people's court's acceptance or whether it is under the jurisdiction of the court hearing the case. A party is entitled to raise an objection to jurisdiction, but a party's objection to jurisdiction on the ground that it is not a proper defendant does not conform to the above provisions and does not constitute an objection to jurisdiction. Whether a party is a proper defendant shall be determined by the people's court through substantive trial.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2006) Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 34

Appellant (defendant at first instance): Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at Units A, B, C, 1/F, Building 4, Huahong Huayuan, No. 325 Hexiang West Road, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Legal representative: Xu Liping, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Lin Tao, lawyer of Fujian Zhiyuan Law Firm.

Appellee (plaintiff at first instance): Peng Xionghun (PENG STEPHEN), male, born on August 15, 1945, a resident of Hong Kong, residing at Room 28, 9/F, Fu Gao Industrial Centre, No. 21 Minle Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon, Hong Kong.

Agent ad litem: Wang Ping, lawyer of Beijing Tianya Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Wang Ying, lawyer of Beijing Tianya Law Firm.

In the case concerning dispute over a commercial housing pre-sale contract between the appellant Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and the appellee Peng Xionghun (PENG STEPHEN) and the defendant at first instance Hung Yun Group Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. (HUNG YUN GROUP LIMITED), the Fujian High People's Court rendered a civil ruling (2005) Min Min Chu Zi No. 38, dismissing the objection to jurisdiction raised by Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. in this case. Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., dissatisfied with the ruling, appealed to this Court. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to review the case. The review has now been concluded.

Upon review, during the period for filing a statement of defense at first instance, Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. raised an objection to jurisdiction on the ground that it was not a proper defendant in the case, requesting dismissal of the plaintiff's action.

The court of first instance held upon review that: Article 108(1), (2), and (3) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC stipulate that the conditions for instituting an action are: (1) the plaintiff must be a citizen, legal person, or other organization that has a direct interest in the case; (2) there must be a definite defendant; (3) there must be specific claims, facts, and reasons. It can be seen that, with respect to the defendant, so long as the defendant is definite, this condition is satisfied. In this case, the two defendants sued by the plaintiff Peng Xionghun are both definite and have the capacity to be parties to the action. Therefore, in accordance with Article 24 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, which provides that "an action arising from a contract dispute shall be under the jurisdiction of the people's court of the place where the defendant is domiciled or where the contract is performed," and Article 22(3), which provides that "if the domiciles or habitual residences of several defendants in the same action are within the jurisdiction of two or more people's courts, each of those people's courts shall have jurisdiction," the court of first instance has jurisdiction over this case. Since the assertion of Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. that "neither it nor Hung Yun Group Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. (HUNG YUN GROUP LIMITED) is a proper defendant" is unrelated to the determination of jurisdiction over this case, its objection to jurisdiction on this ground against the acceptance of the case by the court of first instance is not adopted by the court of first instance. In accordance with Article 38 and Article 140(1)(2) and (2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, it is ruled that the objection to jurisdiction raised by Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. in this case is dismissed.

Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., dissatisfied with the ruling of first instance, appealed to this Court on the ground that it was not a proper defendant and that the court of first instance applied the law incorrectly.

Opinion of the Court: A party is entitled to raise an objection to jurisdiction. However, according to Article 108(4) and Article 38 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, an objection to jurisdiction refers to whether the case is subject to the jurisdiction or supervision of the people's court. In this case, Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. raised an objection to jurisdiction on the ground that it was not a proper defendant in the case, which does not fall within the circumstances of an objection to jurisdiction as provided in the Civil Procedure Law. Whether Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. is a proper defendant in this case shall be determined through substantive trial by the people's court. The court of first instance made a ruling on the objection to jurisdiction, applying the law incorrectly, and the ruling shall be quashed.

Since the ruling of first instance was made only in response to the objection to jurisdiction raised by Hongrun Jinyuan (Xiamen) Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and does not involve the litigation rights of Hung Yun Group Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. (HUNG YUN GROUP LIMITED), this ruling need not set forth the status of Hung Yun Group Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. (HUNG YUN GROUP LIMITED) in this appeal.

Pursuant to Article 154 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and Article 188(2) and (3) of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, it is ordered as follows:

The Civil Ruling (2005) Min Min Chu Zi No. 38 of the Fujian High People's Court is quashed.

Presiding Judge: Han Mei

Judge: Li Mingyi

Acting Judge: Song Chunyu

June 2, 2006

Clerk: Song Ge

[Brief Introduction of the Presiding Judge]

Han Mei, Senior Judge: born in 1962, Master of Laws. Appointed as judge of the Supreme People's Court in 2000.
